name: bonairechamber.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 30 form controls have no label.
lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
summary: bonairechamber.com scores 71 out of 100 (C). 4 checks fail now, 25 are at risk, and 31 pass. Fix first: 30 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 30 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /contact/, /en/, /pap/ and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: Complianz was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw cookies _GRECAPTCHA on www.google.com.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 9 elements on /, /contact/, /en/, for example .green.arrow.button and .turquoise. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, /contact/, /en/, for example .linkedin-icon and .facebook-icon. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: 20 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /contact/, /en/, /pap/ and 16 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
The layout holds still while loading
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
